'''Gravity Hook Seven''' was a [[gravity hook]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. Used in secret to house an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. Its docking ring was converted to the team's command center while the loading ring served as a staging point for supply and transport personnel.
